theorem sum_cubic_error {s : Finset ℕ} (Sp Ss eb : ℕ → ℂ) (Mp Ms : ℂ) {U ρ : ℝ} (hρ : 0 < ρ)
    (heb : ∀ b ∈ s, ‖eb b‖ = 1) (hU : ∀ b ∈ s, ‖Ss b - Ms‖ ≤ U)
    (hR : ∑ b ∈ s, ‖Sp b - Mp‖ ^ 2 ≤ ρ ^ 2) :
    ‖∑ b ∈ s, Sp b ^ 2 * Ss b * eb b - Mp ^ 2 * Ms * ∑ b ∈ s, eb b‖ ≤
      U * ∑ b ∈ s, ‖Sp b‖ ^ 2 +
        ρ / 2 * (9 * ‖Ms‖ ^ 2 + (2 * ∑ b ∈ s, ‖Sp b‖ ^ 2 + 2 * s.card * ‖Mp‖ ^ 2) / 9) :=
